player_prompt.intro:
U na Mothami {player_id} ({piece}). Mothami wa tsielelo ke ({opp}).
Kenya tsoelo ka '[a2 a3]' (ho tloha → ho ea).
- Tsoelo e halalela ke tsamayo e ngoe e tlang pele ho sefahleho se selallo.
- Ho fumana ke tsamayo ho tsoa ho mothami wa tsielelo, ho ea sefahlehong sa selallo.
Tsoelo e ngoe e fumana {score_per_capture} masole.
Papali e fela ka mora ho {max_moves} tsoelo au ha mothami a sa na tsoelo e halalelang.

invalid_move.illegal: Ho falla ka tsela e seng molaong.

outcome.cannot_move: Sebapali {player_id} ha se khone ho tsamaea.
outcome.move_limit: Moeli oa ho tsamaea o fihlile.
